etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English stature, from Old French stature, from Latin statūra.

definitions.definition: A person or animal's natural height when standing upright.
Respect (social standing) coming from achievement or development.

quote.citation: 2021 March 28, Phil McNulty, “Albania 0-2 England”, in BBC Sport‎[1]:
quote.text: Mount's cool finish from Kane's pass after Raheem Sterling intercepted Berat Djimsiti's pass was another illustration of his growing stature and Chelsea's rising star must surely be a certain starter when England open their Euro 2020 finals campaign against Croatia at Wembley on 13 June.
